observed_problem: The generic Core interfaces are mostly Profile-driven, but current regression/bootstrap proof is concentrated on W33 and SP001. There is no representative pre-merge evidence that later Weekly issues, ISO-year boundary issues, materially different Thematic structures, bounded Period editions, or dependent Series volumes traverse the same contracts without new edition-specific code.
expected_behavior: Before merge, side-effect-free fixtures must demonstrate that the same generic Core/Profile interfaces accept representative future Weekly, Thematic, Period and Series cases beyond the named first Pilots.
actual_behavior: The candidate has strong W33/SP001 bootstrap tests but lacks explicit W35+/year-boundary Weekly, TS-002-like, TS-003-like, unrelated Thematic, bounded Period, and dependent Foundations-style Series fixtures.
production_workaround: Keep PR #310 draft and do not infer general production readiness from W33/SP001 bootstrap success. WU-012G must add generic non-production fixtures before review resumes.
improvement_action: Implement WU-012G: add side-effect-free fixtures for a later Weekly, ISO-year boundary Weekly, TS-002-like and TS-003-like Thematics, an unrelated synthetic Thematic, monthly/half-year/annual/custom Periods, and dependent/resequenced Series volumes. Do not initialize real Pilots.
